```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(sf, slope, terra)
aoi <- sf::read_sf("dem/aoi.shp")
api_key <- 'b1698eb31759cfb304e80f31650e1a99'
dem <- tempfile(fileext = ".tif")
data <- slope::elevr('GEDTM30', aoi, 'EPSG:4326', api_key, dem)
plot(data)
```
